title: rmmissing
summary: Remove missing elements, rows, or columns.

gpu_support.notes: GPU inputs use exact owner-aware download and class-preserving restoration, including the logical removal mask, so automatic gather remains transparent and explicit residency is preserved.

description: `rmmissing(A)` removes entries containing missing values. For matrices and tables it removes rows by default; passing dimension `2` removes columns.
behaviors: Vectors remove individual missing elements while preserving row or column orientation.
Matrices remove rows by default and columns when `dim` is `2` or the option is `"columns"`.
Tables remove rows with any missing variable entry by default, preserving variable names and row names.
Two-output calls return the result and a logical mask indicating removed rows, columns, or vector elements.

Every integer class has no standard missing value, so integer input is an exact class-preserving no-op with an all-false mask. A typed-integer dimension is a separately declared RunMat extension and MATLAB compatibility mode rejects it before provider access.
